notes: διὰ παντός was split rather than joined, the ASV spreading it over 'at all times' (rules 45, 94); 'times' is the supplied generic noun and the head stays on 'all'.
The supplied 'be' was given to μετά as the prepositional predicate rather than to the subject κύριος (rule 53).
τῆς εἰρήνης is rule 21's named determinerless case: the article is unrepresented and 'of' stays with the noun.
